events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with interactive/photo moments, games and cat-themed displays.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat treats plus chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise through games including a claw machine and scratch-off tickets.
events.caveats: Official brand material calls the experience free and says visitors can stop by; no advance RSVP requirement is published. Giveaways and merchandise prizes are subject to availability/chance.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 17–19, noon–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. This feed preserves only the still-upcoming Sept. 18 and Sept. 19 occurrences.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-inspired Apothékary takeover at SUKOSHI with tongue readings, ingredient education, tincture sampling and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: Tincture samples and kakigori while supplies last; the first 50 guests in line each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture. A separate gift-with-purchase promotion is also offered.
events.caveats: Eventbrite is the advertised registration path. Freebies are limited: first-50 mini tincture and kakigori while supplies last; the free gift tied to the 20% event promotion requires purchase.
events.practical_notes: Friday hours differ from the weekend: Sept. 18 is 1–9 PM; Sept. 19–20 are 9 AM–9 PM.

events.address: Chelsea Triangle, West 14th Street & 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day public KILIAN PARIS activation celebrating the fragrance brand's Cocktails Collection.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples while supplies last. Exclusive gifts are advertised with purchase rather than as unconditional freebies.
events.caveats: Two current event sources agree it is open to the public and runs noon–8 PM. One secondary aggregator renders an inconsistent street-number address; NYC Plugged identifies the venue as Chelsea Triangle at West 14th Street and 9th Avenue, so the tracker preserves the venue/intersection rather than the conflicting number. Gifts require purchase and supplies are limited.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18 only, noon–8 PM, Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District.
